requestedFlow: Open submitted vaccination certificate, approve or reject; no extra form or veterinarian portal

implementation.ui: Association compliance center shows pending vaccination documents and embedded PDF/image preview
implementation.decision: One atomic authenticated staff RPC records manual identification if missing, then the association-specific versioned review
implementation.identity: Existing identity evidence preserved; name-only review records identified, never fabricated verified DOB. Stricter policies and mismatches remain enforced.
implementation.facts: Horse, vaccination dates, certificate classification and original file remain unchanged.
implementation.rejection: Explicit vaccine rejection is respected even when routine association review is optional.

validation.browser: FR/EN mobile and desktop, preview, approve/reject without re-entry, saved decisions, errors, missing-file guard and PDF iframe
